rv.q: This is a wonderful production for both adults and children.
Drury Lane’s glorious new production of ANNIE is everything.
With so much talent and a touching message for the whole family, Drury Lane’s “Annie” will be the heartwarming holiday hit of the season.
Drury Lane's production of Annie will transport you back to childhood, when you just wanted to feel loved and experience the tingling joy and excitement of watching live theater.
This production, directed by Scott Weinstein, on the stage at Drury Lane is one of the best I have seen ( and I have seen many productions, as well as appeared in one) over the years.

cn.t: Drury Lane's production of the beloved musical earns warm praise as a heartwarming holiday treat. Critics laud the show's positive message and family appeal, with particular praise for its lead performance.
